results.title: Polymorphic indexed vector map with nil and cons equations
results.source: docs/proposals/new/1/sections/05-dependent.tex: ordinary Vec.map motive; fresh indexed datatype, independent constructor equations and executable values
results.transcript:
:{
inductive RecursionVec (A : Type) : Nat → Type where
  | nil : RecursionVec A 0
  | cons {n : Nat} : A → RecursionVec A n → RecursionVec A (n + 1)
:}
:{
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let providers := (← liftCoreM Leant2.sessionConstants) ++ Leant2.curatedProviders
  if providers.contains `RecursionVec.map then throwError "benchmark forbids synthesis provider RecursionVec.map"
:}
:synth extended_candidate : ∀ (A B : Type), (A → B) → ∀ n, RecursionVec A n → RecursionVec B n
:{
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  if (Leant2.resultBinding? (← getEnv) `it1).isSome then
    elabCommand (← `(example : ∀ (A B : Type), (A → B) → ∀ n, RecursionVec A n → RecursionVec B n := it1))
    elabCommand (← `(example : ∀ (A B : Type) (g : A → B), @it1 A B g 0 .nil = .nil := by intros; rfl))
    elabCommand (← `(example : ∀ (A B : Type) (g : A → B) (n : Nat) (x : A) (xs : RecursionVec A n), @it1 A B g (n + 1) (.cons x xs) = .cons (g x) (@it1 A B g n xs) := by intros; rfl))
    elabCommand (← `(#eval if decide ((match @it1 Nat Bool (fun n => n == 0) 3 (.cons 0 (.cons 7 (.cons 0 .nil))) with | .cons a (.cons b (.cons c .nil)) => a == true && b == false && c == true) = true ∧ (match @it1 Bool Nat (fun b => if b then 2 else 9) 3 (.cons false (.cons true (.cons false .nil))) with | .cons a (.cons b (.cons c .nil)) => a == 9 && b == 2 && c == 9) = true) then "EXTENDED_REPLAY_OK" else "EXTENDED_REPLAY_FALSE"))
:}
:quit
